Éireann Operated by Iarnród Éireann Platforms 2 Construction Structure type At-grade Platform levels 2 Accessible Yes Other information Station code SHILL Fare zone Suburban 2 History Opened 1 May 1837 (as Salthill) Original company Dublin and Kingstown Railway Pre-grouping Dublin and South Eastern Railway Post-grouping Great Southern Railways Key dates 1863 Station renamed Salthill and Monkstown 1960 Station closed 1983 Station upgraded 1984 Station reopened for DART 2009 Station refurbished Location Salthill and Monkstown railway station ( Irish : Stáisiún Chnoc an tSalainn agus Baile na Manach ) serves the areas of Salthill (on the coast) and Monkstown (just inland) in Dublin , Ireland. It is on the DART line between the stations of Seapoint and Dún Laoghaire . The station has a car park, information office, automated ticket and vending machines. The information office is open between 05:45–00:15, Monday to Sunday. [ citation needed ] History [ edit ] The original Salthill station

It was built by the Dublin and Kingstown Railway . It closed in 1960 and was electrified and reopened in 1984 with the arrival of DART services. [ 1 ] Services [ edit ] The station is not staffed, it features no toilets and there is no Wi-Fi. There is also no enclosed waiting room, but there are multiple passenger shelters on both sides of the track. There are 2 ticket machines within the station, and a night gate is opened during the evening. [ 2 ] There used to be a vending machine within the building however it has since been removed.
